_philosophy: Floor throughputs for the PERF[...] lines printed by PerformanceBaselineTests.
Floors catch algorithmic regressions (O(n) -> O(n^2), accidental sync I/O,
quadratic re-scans), NOT tuning noise. Basis: ~50% of the SLOWEST observed
CI first measurement (GitHub macos-latest), not local numbers: identical code
varies about 2.5x between CI runners. Floors stay several times above known
regression values (store.steadyStateAppend measured 2.3k/sec before its fix
against a 9.8k floor), so the gate still fails on order-of-magnitude
regressions while a slow runner does not trip it.
The gate runs in the advisory perf-floors.yml workflow, never as a required check.
Raise floors deliberately after intentional performance improvements;
lower them only with a written justification in the PR. If a benchmark is
renamed or removed, update this file in the same change - the gate fails
when a floored benchmark stops reporting.
Checked by scripts/check-perf-floors.sh against captured swift-test output.
_units: operations per second, matching each benchmark's PERF line
